title: RootDelegationProduction
description: A delegation from the BANZA protocol root to a purpose-specific signing key, produced under the 2-of-3 root-key ceremony. Public material only: a delegation id, the purpose (release/BRL/artifact/evidence signing), the delegated ed25519 PUBLIC key (base64url), a validity window, and at least 2 of 3 custodian signatures over the delegation. NO private key, seed or passphrase appears here. Delegated keys sign protocol releases, BANZA Revocation Lists, protocol artifacts and evidence bundles — they NEVER sign payments, NEVER authorise operators and NEVER move funds. A delegation whose purpose implied payment authority, operator authorisation or fund movement is FORBIDDEN and makes the ceremony INVALID (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_INVALID_SCOPE). Status is computed in Rust by engines/banza-root-ceremony :: validate_root_ceremony, never in TypeScript.
_authority: Root Trust Ceremony (2-of-3 offline custody, docs/governance PKI trust model)
_boundary: Root trust for the BANZA open financial protocol. The root does NOT authorise payment services, does NOT create operators, does NOT issue licences, does NOT move/settle/hold funds, and does NOT replace operator regulatory authorisation. BANZA remains an open financial protocol; PSPs/banks/authorised operators are separate entities that implement it.

purpose.description: What the delegated key may sign. Protocol artifacts only — never payments, operators or funds.

delegated_public_key.description: Delegated PUBLIC key material only (base64url, ed25519). Private keys are NEVER included.

valid_from.description: Start of the delegation validity window.

valid_until.description: End of the delegation validity window.

signatures.description: Custodian signatures over the canonical delegation bytes. At least 2 of 3 required (M2_ROOT_CEREMONY_BLOCKED_BY_THRESHOLD if fewer).

key_id.description: Root key id that produced this signature.

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical delegation (base64url, ed25519). Public material.
